name: Close
description: Close is a sales customer relationship management platform that combines lead and opportunity management with email, calling, SMS, automation, and reporting. Sales teams use it to organize prospective customers, manage pipelines, coordinate follow-up, and track deals from first contact to completion.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Close organization through Relay Console OAuth, then let agents use three bounded read-only tools for Organization and Opportunity summaries. Close grants API-key-equivalent access, but Relay V1 excludes leads, contacts, communications, notes, custom fields, users, writes, reports, exports, arbitrary searches, pagination, and raw API access.

capabilities.label: Read opportunities

approvalRequired.label: Read organization

approvalRequired.label: List opportunities

blocked.label: Change CRM records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, bulk-changing, merging, or deleting Close records is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private CRM data
blocked.description: Leads, contacts, phone numbers, email addresses, communications, activities, notes, files, and custom fields are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader Close data
blocked.description: Users beyond the authorizing user, tasks, sequences, workflows, inboxes, reporting, integrations, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary searches
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, filters, search queries, fields, grouping, pages, and raw API access are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export Close data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, bulk APIs, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact-organization binding, Close-granted authority, static requests, limits, audit, redaction, refresh rotation, revocation, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three bounded Close read wrappers and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must create the Close OAuth app, request public distribution for customers outside Relay's own organization, configure Railway staging credentials, and authorize a representative Close organization. Those provider-console actions are outside this code-only task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create the Relay Console OAuth app with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/close/callback, request public access, configure Railway staging credentials, then verify organization choice, exact organization and user binding, rotating refresh, revocation, all three reads, permission denial, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Close lets developers create confidential OAuth apps with an HTTPS callback; apps are private by default and require a public-access request for authorization by other Close customers.
Close uses authorization code OAuth, all.full_access plus offline_access, one-hour access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and an authenticated revoke endpoint.
GET /api/v1/me/ identifies the exact current user and organization membership used to verify the token response binding.
GET /api/v1/organization/:id/ returns organization metadata; Relay requests and returns only bounded non-member summary fields.
Close supports limited Opportunity listing with explicit fields and sorting; Relay fixes these parameters, caps results at twenty-five, and does not paginate or accept a query.
Close supports exact Opportunity retrieval with an explicit field list; Relay excludes lead, contact, note, custom-field, attachment, user-name, and communication data.
